articles.title: Tether putting $23 billion gold stockpile to work with bullion-backed loans
articles.snippet: The stablecoin issuer is extending its tokenized gold strategy by allowing holders of XAUT to borrow against their bullion, mirroring bitcoin-backed lending without selling the underlying asset.
